meta.title: aeval eval control
meta.description: Host-side control plugin that binds one evaluation trial's run binding, gateway-lease budget, fork lineage, and bundle descriptor to a DSH session, and reports its control status in the Web UI.

en.controlRowNote: The control row ${CONTROL_ROW_ID} is inserted by the patch the aeval runner writes (this bundle's default patch only inserts the transport row).
en.label: aeval control
en.modeActive: active u2014 the control stack is mounted (run binding / budget / descriptor live)
en.modeFailed: failed u2014 the host half failed to load
en.modeNotMounted: not-mounted u2014 this profile does not compose the plugin
en.modeStandalone: standalone u2014 only the transport row is mounted, no control configuration is bound, model calls are not redirected
en.modeUnknown: unknown u2014 rows are composed but their phase cannot be classified
en.peerHint: When the peer version window does not match, DSH skips the whole bundle: this chip will not appear at all then u2014 open the sidebar Plugins page and read that bundle's anomaly label (incompatible-version).
en.readonly: read-only: this chip never enables, disables, or edits the profile.
en.standaloneIsDesign: standalone is the designed default, not a fault: installing the plugin redirects no model call.
en.stepEnv: export ${CONFIG_ENV}=${CONFIG_EXAMPLE} (no patch edit; takes effect after the profile restarts)
en.stepFailed: the host writes the reason its half failed to load to stderr / the profile log; fix it and restart the profile u2014 this chip re-reads the phase.
en.stepFailedTitle: next step: repair the host half
en.stepInstall: add and enable dsh-eval-control on the sidebar Plugins page; when a bundle carries the incompatible-version anomaly label, DSH loads none of its rows.
en.stepPatch: or add two lines to the profile cordis.patch.yml (an id override of the transport row config):
en.stepTitle: next step: attach the control stack (either one)
en.title: aeval evaluation control status (read-only)
